name: Nidoking (CobbleEffort form)
look: a huge hunched charcoal brute on massive forearms armoured in pale hexagonal stone, translucent quartz crystals down its back, a spiky crest, cream crescent ears, a grimace of cream teeth, a grey belly, white claws and a long thick tail curving up
entry: Quartz crystals grow down its back as the magma inside it cools, and the oldest ones are taller than a person. It walks on its stone-armoured fists, and one blow of them splits a boulder in two.
how: Wild: ultra-rare in badlands and volcanic biomes.
